mapper.select: SELECT id, login_identity_id, membership_tier, quota_balance_minor, quota_period_started_at, quota_period_ends_at, membership_expires_at FROM user_membership_quota WHERE login_identity_id = #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT id, login_identity_id, membership_tier, quota_balance_minor, quota_period_started_at, quota_period_ends_at, membership_expires_at FROM user_membership_quota WHERE login_identity_id = #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: WITH grants AS ( SELECT raw."loginIdentityId" AS login_identity_id, raw."membershipTier" AS membership_tier, raw."quotaBalanceMinor" AS quota_balance_minor, raw."quotaPeriodStartedAt" AS quota_period_started_at, raw."quotaPeriodEndsAt" AS quota_period_ends_at, raw."membershipExpiresAt" AS membership_expires_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{grantsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( "loginIdentityId" BIGINT, "membershipTier" SMALLINT, "quotaBalanceMinor" BIGINT, "quotaPeriodStartedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "quotaPeriodEndsAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "membershipExpiresAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ) UPDATE user_membership_quota SET membership_tier = grants.membership_tier, quota_balance_minor = grants.quota_balance_minor, quota_period_started_at = grants.quota_period_started_at, quota_period_ends_at = grants.quota_period_ends_at, membership_expires_at = grants.membership_expires_at FROM grants WHERE user_membership_quota.login_identity_id = grants.login_identity_id
